planner.heading: Plan review
planner.assessment_note: An AI reading of this plan. It is an opinion, not a checked fact.

state.not_run: No plan analysis was run for this campaign.
state.proposed: {count, plural, one {The planner proposed # change to this plan.} other {The planner proposed # changes to this plan.}}
state.proposed_nothing: The planner reviewed the plan and proposed no changes.
state.capped: Plan analysis is paused: the daily limit was reached.

reason.quota_exceeded: the trial allowance is used up
reason.rate_limited: too many AI requests in the last minute
reason.input_token_cap_exceeded: the plan needed more context than allowed
reason.output_token_per_turn_exceeded: the answer was longer than allowed
reason.output_token_cap_exceeded: the reasoning ran longer than allowed
reason.max_turns_exceeded: it did not reach an answer in time
reason.invalid_response: the answer could not be read
reason.provider_error: the AI service returned an error
reason.internal_error: something went wrong on our side
reason.no_brief: there is no brief to analyse

kind.request_evidence: Keep it only if you can add evidence for it

superseded_reason.version_advanced: The brief moved on after this was proposed.
superseded_reason.brief_frozen: The brief was approved, so this can no longer be applied.

round.note: Nothing is applied until you press Apply. Selected proposals are applied together.
round.apply_hint: Select at least one proposal to apply.

result.applied: {count, plural, one {Applied # change. The brief has been re-checked.} other {Applied # changes. The brief has been re-checked.}}
result.applied_recheck_pending: {count, plural, one {Applied # change.} other {Applied # changes.}} The re-check did not finish, so Approve stays hidden until it does.

already.accepted: Someone else already accepted this proposal.
already.rejected: Someone else already rejected this proposal.
already.superseded_version_advanced: This proposal is out of date: the brief moved on.
already.superseded_brief_frozen: This proposal is out of date: the brief was approved.
already.unknown: This proposal is no longer waiting for a decision.

conflict.conflicting_proposals: Two selected proposals change the same post in ways that cannot both apply. Choose one of them.
conflict.stale_target_order: One selected proposal points at a position that no longer exists. Reload the page and choose again.
conflict.conflicting_reorders: Two selected proposals move different posts to the same position. Choose one of them.
conflict.invalid_reorder_target: One selected proposal moves a post to a position that would not exist after the other changes. Adjust your selection and try again.

error.invalid_input: That request was not valid. Reload the page and try again.
error.unauthorized: You need to sign in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this brief.
error.not_found: This brief could not be found.
error.invalid_brief_state: This brief is not waiting for review right now.
error.already_approved: This brief was already approved, so it can no longer change.
error.concurrent_edit: Someone else changed this brief while you were reading. Reload and try again.
error.nothing_applied: None of the selected proposals could be applied. They may already be decided.
error.empty_sequence: Applying these would remove every post from the plan, so nothing was changed. Keep at least one post.
error.invalid_result: The applied plan is not valid. Regenerate the brief.

transient.heading: Approve is hidden while the brief is re-checked
transient.body: The plan changed, so its earlier review no longer applies. Approve returns as soon as the new check is done.

claims.heading: Claims in this post
claims.no_corpus: No evidence corpus: claims not checked
claims.not_checked: Claims in this post were not checked
claims.no_claims: No checkable claims in this post
claims.all_cited: {count, plural, one {The claim in this post is cited.} other {All # claims in this post are cited.}}
claims.cited_explainer: “Cited” means the claim points to evidence that was given to the AI. It does not guarantee the sentence matches that evidence. Read it and decide.
claims.summary: {cited} cited, {uncited} without a citation, {unknown} citing unknown evidence
claims.unlocated: This claim could not be located in the text.

cite.label: Choose existing evidence
cite.empty: There is no stored evidence to choose from.

error.invalid_input: That request was not valid. Reload the page and try again.
error.unauthorized: You need to sign in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to review this post.
error.not_found: This post could not be found.
error.conflict: This post changed while you were reading. Reload and try again.
error.not_checked: This post has no claim check to update.
error.unknown_evidence: That evidence is not available to link.

redundancy.heading: Repetition in this campaign
redundancy.overlap: Repeats the post at position {position} of this campaign's plan: {percent}% of the wording overlaps.
redundancy.explainer: This is a structural word-overlap comparison, not a judgment of quality. Nothing was changed, and you can still approve. Read both posts and decide.
